race.description: Happy Birthday Val Morgan Mdn Pace
race.comment: STORMS (7) resumes from a spell of eight months after closing off last campaign in good form, the last run being a solid third over 1680m at Terang. The driver has some work to do from this wide starting position. Well-placed to take this out. CRYPTO CROOK (2) made a good start to her career six days ago, beaten a head into second over 1609m at Charlton. Has the benefit of a good draw. Primary contender in a similar race. BANGBANG BOBBIE (3) is looming as a real threat after a better effort last start, finishing second at Mt Gambier over 1780m. HALF AS TOUGH (6) is worth another chance after a last-start ninth over 1609m at Charlton six days ago.
